Final for Publication

Application No. 23138-T1

4701-25 W. North Avenue (“Subject Property”)
Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment

Substitute Narrative and Plans

The Applicant, 4701 LLC, is proposing a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment from a M2-2, Light
Industry District to a C3-2, Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment District. The Subject
Property is improved with various buildings that will be demolished as part of this
redevelopment.

The Applicant is acquiring the Subject Property with the intent of constructing a new gas station
with a convenience retail store component. The Subject Property is located within 1,000 feet of
an existing gas station. Therefore, pursuant to Section 17-9-0109-H of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance (“Ordinance”), this application must be approved as a Type 1 Zoning Map
Amendment.

The Subject Property is within 2,640 feet of the Grand/Cicero Metra Station. Therefore, the
development must comply with to Section 17-3-0308 of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
(“Ordinance”) regarding the standards and regulations of the Pedestrian Streets. The Applicant
is seeking a variation of the Landscaping and Screening as set forth in Section 17-11-0202 of the
Ordinance, as well as the Parking Location pursuant to Section 17-3-0504-F, as designed on the
Site Plan, and any other deficiencies in the vehicular use area and other perimeter requirements.

The Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment is required pursuant to 17-9-0109-H, because the Subject
Property is within 1,000 feet of an existing gas station. The proposed building is approximately
4,620 square feet. The proposed redevelopment has 15 parking spaces, however, only 5 spaces
are required. In addition, there will be 6 gas pumps with dual nozzle dispensers. The overall
height of the building is approximately 30 feet, but pursuant to the Chicago Zoning Ordinance
based on the slot frontage, the maximum height is 50 feet.

Proposed Zoning: M2-2, Light Industry District to a C3-2, Commercial,
Manufacturing and Employment District
1) Floor Area and Floor Area Ratio

a) Lot Area 32,452 Sq. Ft.
b) Total building area 4,620 Sq. Ft.
c) FAR 2.2 allowed: 0.14 actual
2) Amount of off-street parking 5 pursuant to Sec. 17-10-0207-R; 15 parking spaces
will be provided

3) Setbacks Front: 0.0 Ft. required; 79 Ft. actual
